518.issue_title: Repair remaining checker suppressions on the migrated baseline

cycles.cycle_name: Cut over model-only core contracts and narrow stored facts

deliverables.description: Make core/outer/prepared input contracts model-only, preserve variance, forward each existing concrete model, and migrate direct None-based doubles/calls to typed-empty admission without compatibility. Preserve schema/model identity and rejection attachments. Explicitly migrate AttachedCore and ProjectionCore to typed-empty inputs and verify their existing real SDK transport/presentation files alongside all discovered direct consumers.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Narrow Literal attributes and existing source seams
deliverables.description: Annotate the four stored reason/stage exception contracts, supply existing generic-binding/schema-callback types and use the already-resolved HEAD hexsha. Preserve public values, causes, bytes and selected Git snapshot.

cycles.exit_criteria: Focused existing green baseline and corrected tests include AttachedCore/ProjectionCore real SDK transport/presentation plus the actual direct model-only consumers; changed-file gates pass. No artificial RED for declaration cleanup; typed-empty/model/attachment and Literal/Git snapshot invariants hold; no None bridge, variance change or new business policy.

cycles.cycle_name: Preserve primary logging events with typed payload admission

deliverables.deliverable_name: Robust formatter payload and collision behavior
deliverables.description: Adapt existing logging tests to expose missing malformed/collision guarantees with meaningful RED, then implement the approved small typed carrier and standard strict per-property JSON admission in the existing formatter. Preserve base metadata/traceback, valid flat siblings, safe diagnosis and valid reserved values; no custom recursive framework. Complete producer positive/negative controls within C_2 using strict native Mypy and explicitly enabled relevant Pyright rules in temporary control files; C_3 later repeats applicable controls under restored native Pyright defaults.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Typed audit and process context producers
deliverables.description: Migrate the current nine producer modules to known typed props, retain per-event ISO time as event_timestamp, and ensure cleanup directory/cause are emitted. Preserve restart marker/result/timestamps/event identities/exit42 and handler ownership; no new marker business schema.

cycles.exit_criteria: Meaningful logging RED recorded before repair; focused formatter/restart/cleanup behavior passes, including raw extra bypass, invalid roots/nested data/keys/nonfinite/cycles, collisions, primary trace and sibling/context/time preservation. Before C_2 exit, strict native Mypy and temporary-file-enabled Pyright producer controls prove clean positives and intended negatives; source gates pass. Natural-policy Pyright replay is explicitly C_3 evidence, not a prerequisite silently deferred from C_2.

cycles.cycle_name: Describe raw boundaries and restore production strict signals

deliverables.description: Repair existing raw object/container inference and carry proved native request/report/context values across the eight Python adapter files. Preserve exact wire/root/index/order/version/config/native-write behavior and package isolation; no host models, assumed schemas, framework or silent coercion.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Host dynamic owners and native strict signals
deliverables.description: Repair config/model/context/presentation/cache/local collections/factories/YAML/remaining SDK metadata at their existing owners. Restore the approved Pyright strict defaults without enabling the four native-default-none policies; preserve runtime guards/nullability/variance/default freshness and use precise justified library boundaries only where source evidence requires. Complete model-only/Literal/variance/library controls within C_3 and replay applicable logging controls under restored native policy with temporary enabling headers removed.

cycles.exit_criteria: Focused existing owner tests and changed-file gates pass; current restored-policy findings are causally classified/fixed within approved owners. Before C_3 exit, model-only/Literal/variance/library controls and applicable logging replay under actual restored native Pyright defaults show clean positives/intended negatives. Useful guards/native diagnosis/default freshness and precise exception rationale remain; no unchecked cast, blanket disable or extra four-rule policy.

cycles.cycle_name: Finish precise local exceptions and bounded test policy

deliverables.deliverable_name: Ordinary helpers and precise necessary test exceptions
deliverables.description: Correct the three untyped helpers, indexed lambdas/private/mock/B017 cases and ordinary annotations; remove broad tests ANN/ARG and tests.* untyped relaxations only with exact necessary interface/fixture/invalid cases handled. Preserve public keyword contracts and invocation-time Settings/fixture behavior; no whole-test Mypy gate or suite rewrite.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Complete local disposition and activation evidence
deliverables.description: Resolve each remaining equivalent local group against final combined policy: remove dormant/unused/dead directives/helpers, keep source-demonstrated terminal/variance/library/timing exceptions with rationale/trigger, and reuse fresh C_2/C_3 sensitivity evidence, completing only remaining test-policy/local controls here without permanent diagnostic tests. Review actual final inventory, activate final source via restart/fresh context/health and prepare the Implementation handover.

cycles.exit_criteria: Affected helper/import/fixture/public behavior tests and target gates pass; seven-independent/twelve-masked distinction resolved under final policy; actual remaining directives all have rationale/trigger. Reuse fresh completed C_2/C_3 controls and complete only invalidated/remaining final-local/test-policy evidence; unused-code scan is honestly classified, final source activated, no stale runtime claim or expanded gate policy.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Durable full native validation and actual dispositions
deliverables.description: Record one full native suite and all required gates, preserved behavior/type/source mapping, actual remove/narrow/retain dispositions with exact rationale and triggers, negative/incomplete history, safe reproduction and residual/deferred work.
Reconcile the existing type-checking playbook with implemented source-first/precise exception policy and actual model-only boundaries without duplicating per-issue instructions.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Current logging data and diagnosis contract
deliverables.description: Document actual formatter-owned metadata, event_timestamp, flat valid props and explicit safe payload/collision diagnosis in the existing server configuration reference; preserve unrelated launcher/config documentation.
